DIAGNOSIS READY: Rectal Cancer.

The clinical picture of painless, daily rectal bleeding in a 45-year-old female with a palpable mass is highly suspicious for malignancy. Since the Pelvic MRI images were not provided in the initial report, I require you to return those images immediately to better evaluate the extent of the tumor and local invasion.
